messages.content: Notes for Ashgrove Plastics: 'Pro plan, 10/10 seats used' / 'recurring Mon pickup Ashgrove plant set up in DockSync' / 'missed 14:00 cutoff 3x, pickups slid to next day' / 'wants 11th user'. What should I tell them?

Ashgrove Plastics is on Track Pro and has used all 10 seats. Adding an 11th user means upgrading to Track Enterprise ($499/month, unlimited users). Their recurring Monday pickup is running in DockSync. They've missed the 14:00 CT same-day cutoff 3 times, so ask them to put ad-hoc pickup requests in earlier in the day.
Which hazmat classes do we take, and can it go through Kessler Bay?
We take Classes 3, 8 and 9 only, with 24 hours' notice, routed through HJX and MFT. Kessler Bay doesn't handle hazmat at all. Class 1 and Class 7 are never accepted.
Who's the dock supervisor at Harlow Junction if I need someone to check a pallet?
Marcus Leland is the HJX dock supervisor. Give him the PRO and handling-unit suffix, for example 382-671-352-06, so his team can find the pallet by scanning its PalletPass label.
We opened a delivery from Friday and found two cartons of glass panels crushed inside the shrink wrap. Outside of the pallet looked fine so our receiver signed clean. PRO 382-402-118. What do we do?

PRO 382-402-118: delivered Friday, so you're within the 5-calendar-day window for concealed damage. File an OS&D claim in the Track portal (Claims tab) with photos of the cartons and packaging, the BOL and the commercial invoice. The claims team will acknowledge it within 48 hours and issue a decision within 30 days.
We ordered 6 pallets and only 5 showed up. Driver said the 6th might be at the terminal. BOL BL-448213, PRO 382-671-352. We noted it on the delivery receipt.

PRO 382-671-352: handling unit -06 scanned at HJX but missed the trailer. It's going out on Thursday 10:00–12:00 CT at no charge. You noted the shortage on the delivery receipt, so if it doesn't arrive in that window you're covered for an OS&D claim. Claims are filed in the Track portal.
Track portal has shown 'At HJX' for two days on PRO 382-788-093. Is it lost?

PRO 382-788-093: it isn't lost. It's loaded on this morning's HJX outbound and scheduled for delivery today 14:00–16:00 CT. The Track status lagged because the trailer scan posted late. This shipment missed its 2-business-day SLA by one day, so I've flagged it for the service-failure review.
can u confirm our appointment for tomorrow? PRO 382-871-033
PRO 382-871-033: confirmed for tomorrow 08:00–10:00 CT in DockSync. The driver will call the consignee number on the BOL about 30 minutes before arrival.
Our customer is asking for proof of delivery for PRO 382-886-219. Where can I get the POD?

PRO 382-886-219: delivered Monday at 11:14 CT and signed by T. Vasquez. You can download the signed POD from the Track portal under the PRO's Documents tab, or share the tracking link directly with your customer.
what are your payment terms? our AP team is asking

Brightline invoices are net 30. If a charge looks wrong, file the dispute within 10 business days of the invoice date. Approved credit memos are issued within 5 business days. Billing lead Priya Halvorsen is reachable at billing@brightline.example.com.
